title: Chapter 42
text: ∫ the dream I was having this dream I was standing in this room and the tiniest little man walked in. he said “I am the Rope Man and you are going to strangle yourself.” I said “oh no I’m not.” “oh yes you are,” he told me, “it’s automatic.” in front of him was a little wooden spool and some rope was wrapped around it. then in front of me was a mound of rope I reached down got a handful began winding it around my neck I tried to stop myself I couldn’t I wound the rope tighter and tighter then began pulling at it strangling myself. then I heard my wife she was screaming at Bugger one of our cats the young one who hadn’t been fixed yet and every morning about 5:30 a.m. Bugger started attacking one of our other cats. awakened I got up and pulled Bugger off the other cat carried him down the stairway opened the front door gently eased him outside. then I went back upstairs got into bed decided not to tell my wife about the dream she took such things too seriously but I couldn’t help wondering how that dream might have ended Bugger might have saved my life for that I decided to let him keep his balls maybe into the Spring.
